Manage AMFI policy and boot-argument configuration; repeat the same enable/disable action and `--final-state` to resume a retained operation.

```text
pomme amfi SUBCOMMAND
```

## pomme amfi status

Show AMFI status and restore the VM state.

```text
pomme amfi status [NAME] [--final-state FINAL_STATE] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--final-state FINAL_STATE` | Final VM state: previous, stopped, normal, recovery, or paused. For a retained enable/disable operation, repeat the same action and `--final-state` to resume. Values: `previous`, `stopped`, `normal`, `recovery`, `paused`. Default: `previous`. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme amfi enable

Restore the saved AMFI configuration and the VM state.

```text
pomme amfi enable [NAME] [--force] [--final-state FINAL_STATE] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f`, `--force` | Allow owner creation and automatic login on a verified fresh VM without confirmation. |
| `--final-state FINAL_STATE` | Final VM state: previous, stopped, normal, recovery, or paused. For a retained enable/disable operation, repeat the same action and `--final-state` to resume. Values: `previous`, `stopped`, `normal`, `recovery`, `paused`. Default: `previous`. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme amfi disable

Configure AMFI as disabled and restore the VM state.

```text
pomme amfi disable [NAME] [--force] [--final-state FINAL_STATE] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f`, `--force` | Allow owner creation and automatic login on a verified fresh VM without confirmation. |
| `--final-state FINAL_STATE` | Final VM state: previous, stopped, normal, recovery, or paused. For a retained enable/disable operation, repeat the same action and `--final-state` to resume. Values: `previous`, `stopped`, `normal`, `recovery`, `paused`. Default: `previous`. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
